title: Accepted main is read and written through detached transactions
summary: The normal checkout is only a Git handle. Accepted dependencies are read from an exact detached snapshot of origin/main; accepted publication/evidence writes use a separate detached main transaction. A dirty or stale ordinary checkout is not an error condition.
invariants: Do not clean, reset, stash or fast-forward the ordinary checkout merely to run Autobuild.
A read-only snapshot fetches exact remote main, creates a detached worktree, then releases the repository lease while immutable content is consumed.
A write transaction stages/commits/pushes in its detached worktree and then removes it.
Dependency planning must use the accepted-main snapshot as REPO_ROOT, not the caller's potentially stale checkout.

provenance.claim: Core rules explicitly separate repository lease, accepted-main snapshots and ordinary checkout.
Git revision snapshot and main transaction objects.
Orchestrator builds dependency floor and executes from accepted-main snapshot.
